key_concepts: Decantation separates a less-dense substance from a denser one
The mixture is left undisturbed during decantation
The less-dense substance can be removed by scooping or slowly pouring
Decantation can separate two liquids that do not mix
Oil and water form separate layers when left undisturbed
Oil floats on water because it is less dense
The top oil layer can be poured into another vessel
Floating fats in sinigang can be removed by decantation or scooping
Gasoline in water can be separated by decantation
Mud and water can be separated by decantation
Decantation can help remove oil or gasoline from an oil spill
Decantation is not applicable to all types of mixtures
